issue-4423: Requests that prefer French by quality value get English responses
Opened by repomind-bot on 2026-10-27

The mobile client sends `Accept-Language: en;q=0.3, fr-FR;q=0.9`. Over the past
week 2,140 upload error responses to it came back in English, although French
has the higher weight in

text:
This issue points out that the API does not respect the quality value (`q`) attributes in the `Accept-Language` header to determine the preferred language for a response. Instead, it picks the first supported language listed, overlooking cases where lower-priority languages have higher `q` values. This behavior causes responses to default to English even when French is preferred, based on the `q` weighting.

This appears to be a bug or missing feature in the request processing that should handle language preferences based on `q` values appropriately. I'll look into the code involved in handling language preferences.
